resources.string: Every scheme runs on this device with BouncyCastle. Each operation is checked as it is timed: the receiver must get the same secret and every signature must verify.

resources.string: Public key %1$d B · sent back %2$d B

ML-KEM is often faster than X25519 and ECDH while its keys are about 40 times bigger. ML-DSA signs and verifies quickly with signatures of a few kilobytes. SLH-DSA keys are as small as Ed25519 keys, but it pays with slow signing or very big signatures.
